title: HR Assistant Manager
description:
We're recruiting a 12-month fixed-term maternity cover for an experienced HR Assistant Manager to support multiple office locations including Milton Keynes, Peterborough and Birmingham. This is a hands-on, operational People role combining employee relations, stakeholder coaching, people projects, and team leadership within a growing and ambitious business.

Client Details

Our client is a leading UK professional services organisation with a strong people-first culture and ambitious growth plans. Following significant investment and continued expansion, they are looking for an experienced HR professional to join their People team and provide support across several regional offices, partnering closely with managers and employees to deliver a high-quality HR service.

Description

As a People Manager, you will provide pragmatic and commercially focused HR support across a portfolio of office locations, working closely with leaders and employees to drive positive people outcomes.

Key responsibilities include:
- Managing a broad range of employee relations cases, including performance management, absence, disciplinary, grievance and capability matters.
- Providing generalist HR advice and guidance to managers and employees.
- Coaching and developing a junior member of the People team.
- Supporting organisational and people-related projects.
- Building strong relationships with stakeholders across multiple sites.
- Promoting best practice and ensuring HR policies and processes are applied consistently.
- Analysing trends and identifying opportunities to improve employee experience and people processes.
- Supporting business growth by partnering with operational leaders on workforce and people matters.
- This is a hybrid role requiring regular travel between offices in Milton Keynes, Peterborough and Leicester, with occasional travel to Birmingham as required. Travel expenses are fully covered in line with company policy.

Profile

The successful candidate will be an experienced HR professional who enjoys building relationships, solving problems and providing practical, people-focused advice.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience in a generalist HR position such as HR Advisor, HR Business Partner or People Manager.
- Strong employee relations experience and confidence managing a range of ER cases independently.
- Experience coaching, mentoring or managing more junior team members.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- A professional, credible and approachable style with the ability to engage employees at all levels.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage a varied workload across multiple locations.
- A proactive and positive approach, with a genuine passion for HR and supporting people.
- A full UK driving licence and willingness to travel regularly between regional offices.

Job Offer

Competitive salary, negotiable depending on experience.

12-month fixed-term contract covering maternity leave.

Hybrid working model with flexibility around working hours.

37.5-hour working week with core hours of 10am-2pm.

Business travel expenses covered.

25 days annual leave plus bank holidays

Opportunity to join a growing organisation with strong investment and ambitious plans.

Supportive leadership team and collaborative People function.

Immediate impact role with genuine autonomy and stakeholder exposure.

title: HR Coordinator
company: Bletchley Park Trust Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Title: HR Coordinator

Location: Bletchley Park Sherwood Drive Bletchley Milton Keynes MK3 6 EB

Salary: £27,500 - £29,000 per annum (depending on experience)

Job type: Permanent, Full Time

Working Hours: 37.5 hours per week

Closing Date: Tuesday 3 November 2026, 12.00 noon.

About us:

Bletchley Park is a vibrant heritage attraction, open daily to visitors, revealing the secrets and telling fascinating stories of the secret British World War Two codebreaking operations. The mission of the Bletchley Park Trust is to attract, engage and educate people from all over the world in order to inspire them with Bletchley Park's crucial role in World War Two.

Bletchley Park is a great place to work. Our people are our biggest resource, and we are committed to value, invest in and nurture our team.

About the role:

We have an exciting opportunity for an HR Coordinator to join our team.

Reporting to the Head of HR, you will provide efficient HR coordination and administrative support throughout the employee and volunteer lifecycles. Key duties include coordinating recruitment and onboarding, completing DBS checks, supporting probationary processes and maintaining accurate HR, volunteer and learning records.

You will provide first line HR support to managers, staff and volunteers in line with our policies and employment legislation. You will also support meetings and take accurate notes while maintaining confidentiality and acting with discretion. As part of a small collaborative team, you will also help deliver team social activities, when required.

About you:

To succeed in this role, you will:
- Be approachable, discreet and organised
- Have strong communication skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Have previous HR administration experience, confidence using HR systems and be proficient in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, Teams and SharePoint (essential).
- Support towards a Level 3 HR Support Apprenticeship, or a similar recognised HR qualification may be available, subject to eligibility and funding.

Please click apply to see further details around the person requirements and responsibilities for this role. This is also available to view on the Bletchley Park website.

Working Hours:

This is a full-time, permanent role of 37.5 hours per week, normally worked from 8.30am to 4.30pm. The ability to flex working hours to accommodate some evening / weekend working on an ad hoc basis, will also be required.
- Based on site at Bletchley Park, Milton Keynes (MK3 6 EB)
- Salary £27,500 to £29,000 per annum, depending on experience.

Our benefits include:
- 33 days annual leave per year (including statutory holidays).
- Access to our BUPA Cash Plan and Employee Assistance Scheme
- Six complimentary entry passes per year (after six months service)
- A days' birthday leave (after 12 months service)
- Staff and Volunteer social and wellbeing events

Additional Information:

Closing date for applications: 3 November 2026, 12.00 noon.

Please include a cover letter setting out why you are suitable for this role with your application.

Bletchley Park Trust is committed to, and values the principles of diversity, equality, and inclusion. We strive to provide an inclusive and supportive working environment where all our team feel respected and supported in fulfilling their potential. We acknowledge and value the benefits of a diverse workforce and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and are committed to ensuring that our recruitment process is transparent, fair and as inclusive as possible for all applicants. We are also committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and adults at risk and expect all staff, volunteers and external agencies to share this commitment.

So that you can fully understand the way we use your data, please refer to our Privacy Policy for Recruitment, which can be found on our website.

No agencies please.

If you feel you could be an asset to our team, please click the APPLY button to send your CV and cover letter.

Candidates with relevant experience or a job title of: HR Coordinator, People Coordinator, HR Administrator, People Administrator, HR Assistant, Human Resources Coordinator, Human Resources Administrator may also be considered for this role.

title: Temporary HR Administrator
description:
Temporary HR Administrator

Location: Milton Keynes

Hours: Full Time - Monday to Friday

Contract: Temporary - Immediate Start

Are you an organised, detail-oriented and people-focused HR professional looking for your next opportunity?

We are looking for a HR Administrator to join a busy and collaborative People Team within a well-established retail business. This is a fantastic opportunity to support a fast-paced HR function, helping to deliver an excellent employee experience while ensuring people processes run smoothly, accurately and efficiently.

You will act as a key point of contact for employee and manager queries, supporting a wide range of HR administration activities across the employee lifecycle. The ideal candidate will be proactive, customer-focused and comfortable managing competing priorities in a dynamic environment.

About the role:

Working closely with the People Operations Manager and wider HR team, you will support day-to-day people operations, maintain accurate employee records, coordinate onboarding activities and assist with payroll, benefits and compliance processes.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Act as the first point of contact for employee and manager queries relating to HR policies, annual leave, absence, benefits and people systems.
- Manage the end-to-end onboarding process, including preparing contracts, coordinating background checks and ensuring all pre-employment requirements are completed.
- Maintain accurate employee records and HR systems, carrying out regular data updates, uploads and audits.
- Support payroll accuracy by recording and reconciling absence data across HR systems and identifying discrepancies.
- Administer employee benefits, including Cycle to Work, season ticket loans, healthcare plans and eye care vouchers.
- Support Right to Work checks and monitor expiring documentation, following up with employees and managers as required.
- Prepare employment-related documentation, including reference letters and probation confirmation letters.
- Assist with supplier onboarding, invoice processing and general People Team administration.
- Contribute to process improvements, helping to streamline workflows, improve data accuracy and support the efficient delivery of HR services.

The successful candidate will ideally have:
- At least 12 months' experience working within a busy HR or People function.
- Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
- Excellent attention to detail and a good level of numeracy, with confidence handling employee data.
- Experience using HR systems and maintaining accurate records; knowledge of HRIS platforms, particularly People XD, would be advantageous.
- Previous exposure to payroll administration or payroll-related processes would be beneficial.
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
- Excellent communication and customer service skills, with the confidence to support employees and managers at all levels.
- A proactive, collaborative approach, with a willingness to learn and identify opportunities to improve processes.
- CIPD qualification or part-qualification would be desirable but is not essential.

What's on Offer?
- The opportunity to join a well-established and recognised retail business.
- Experience within a collaborative and supportive People Team.
- Exposure to a broad range of HR and People Operations activities.
- The opportunity to develop your HR administration skills within a fast-paced environment.
- A varied temporary assignment where you can make a real contribution to the employee experience.

If you're an organised and people-focused HR professional who enjoys helping others, keeping processes running smoothly and working as part of a supportive team, we'd love to hear from you!
